latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the internal-comms skill for creating internal communications.
- Supports multiple communication types: 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, status reports, leadership and project updates, and incident reports.
- Provides guidelines and example templates for each communication style in the examples/ directory.
- Includes clear instructions on when and how to use the skill for various internal communication needs.
